summary: Frontend-only mandatory retest completed on public preview. Serialized menu route transaction remains broken for pointer-based navigation: fresh matrix and sequential matrix fail heavily, and quick open-click still lands at ORIGIN. Keyboard routing, home origin, direct timeline lock behavior, gallery/quote/victory interactions, and no error/overflow checks pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Failed 5/5 in this run. Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories clicks each landed at ORIGIN instead of target route.
Failed 4/5 in one session. Only Timeline passed; Legacy remained ORIGIN and Cars/Tracks/Victories stayed at TIMELINE.
Open menu and immediate Timeline click still lands at ORIGIN.

integration_issues.flow: Menu route click -> native capture handler -> spatial route dispatch/landed ack
integration_issues.issue: Menu-driven pointer routing remains non-deterministic. In contrast, direct router invocation (window.__spatialGo) consistently lands routes and preserves timeline lock behavior, isolating failure to menu route transaction path.

action_items: Fix serialized pointer route transaction in menu flow so each pointer click deterministically commits target route before panel close/unmount.
Resolve quick open-click race where first click after opening menu falls back to ORIGIN.
Align menu pointer path with keyboard/direct path behavior (keyboard and direct __spatialGo currently pass consistently).
Retest full mandatory set after fix: fresh matrix, sequential matrix, quick open-click, keyboard, home origin, timeline lock, gallery/quote/victory, no errors/overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav component still combines critical interaction logic into compressed one-line JSX/handlers, making race debugging difficult and increasing regression risk.
Menu close sequencing depends on landed event + timeout but pointer transaction still shows stale route commit; event ordering between capture handler and panel lifecycle is not deterministic.
Spatial router itself appears healthy (direct route calls pass), so bug scope is menu dispatch/ack transaction rather than core spatial math or timeline controls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two UI runs were executed. Run A (menu-driven) failed mandatory pointer criteria: fresh 0/5, sequential 1/5, quick open-click failed; keyboard/home passed; no error selectors and no horizontal overflow. Run B (targeted direct routing) passed timeline lock and gallery/quote/victory interactions, indicating route core works when bypassing menu click transaction.
rca of the issue: Repro: (1) Reload page. (2) Open menu and click Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories; expected respective node labels, observed ORIGIN or stale prior node. (3) Quick open then immediate Timeline click lands ORIGIN. (4) Keyboard Enter/Space and direct window.__spatialGo route transitions pass. RCA: failure is localized to menu pointer transaction sequencing (capture click -> route dispatch -> landed ack -> panel close), with unresolved race leading to dropped or stale route commits before/while menu transition occurs. Mitigation: enforce single deterministic state machine for pointer route commit and defer close until confirmed commit for the exact route key.
